role: The name tag (id 421): renames a living entity to the stack's display name on right click on it.

members.name: itemInteractionForEntity
members.note: a tag without display.Name answers false; otherwise setCustomNameTag and func_110163_bv on the server's living, the stack shrinks on both sides and interactWith destroys the empty stack

notes: Every tag a chest or trade hands out is unnamed (the anvil is off), so in survival the tag does nothing; the dev slot op's "name" gives a named one. use-kinds-s1 names a cow, walks 50 blocks away for 650 ticks (no despawn roll: the persistence skips rand.nextInt(800)), on to 128 blocks until its chunk unloads, and back (CustomName and PersistenceRequired come back from the region store).
